snippet.title: Phantom Blade Zero - Official Release Date Announcement Trailer | 2026.9.9 Worldwide + Wishlist Now
snippet.description:
After four years of intense development, Phantom Blade Zero is officially set to launch worldwide on September 9, 2026. Our wishlist pages on Steam, PlayStation, and the Epic Games Store are now live. We invite you to add the game to your wishlist!

This new trailer unveils a sweeping look at the journey ahead, featuring never-before-seen story moments, new weapons, and new enemies. Beyond the intensity of combat, players will experience the world’s lore, exploration, and progression systems. Our goal is to craft not only the highest standard of martial action, but also a deep and authentic interpretation of Xia, the heart of Chinese heroism.

The support from players everywhere has fueled our passion throughout this long development road. Now the moment is finally drawing near. Join us as we count down to September 9, 2026.
